name: What are the typical steps involved in purchasing an investment property with the help of a real estate agent?

mainEntity.name: What are the typical steps involved in purchasing an investment property with the help of a real estate agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: The typical steps involve an initial consultation to define your investment goals, property search and analysis, offer submission and negotiation, due diligence, securing financing, and finally, closing the deal. Kelby Contreras guides investors through each stage, leveraging market knowledge in areas like Boca Raton or Coral Gables to identify suitable opportunities. A critical preparation step is pre-approval for financing, which strengthens your offer and streamlines the purchase process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Steps include goal setting, property search, offer, due diligence, financing, and closing. Kelby Contreras assists throughout, emphasizing financing pre-approval.
